claims.claim_ar: جذر الفعل: أ م ن. مجال دلالة الجذر الأصلي: الأمن/الاطمئنان، ومن مشتقاته الدلالية في السياق الديني: التصديق/الإيمان.
claims.claim_en: Root: أ م ن (amn). Core semantic field: security/safety/feeling secure; in religious/ethical derivations (e.g., آمَنَ/يُؤْمِنُ) it carries the sense of 'to believe' / 'to have trust'.
claims.needs_review_reason: Initial-hamza verbs show phonological and semantic shifts across forms/contexts; exact nuance (security vs. belief) depends on lexicographic sources and context.

claims.claim_ar: وزن المضارع الظاهر: يُؤْمِنُونَ — فعل ثلاثي مجرد (باب فَعَلَ) في صيغة المضارع الم탠تة مع لاحقة واو الجماعة.
claims.claim_en: Wazn/pattern: the present-tense form يُؤْمِنُونَ — a Form I (triliteral, fa'ala) verb in the imperfect with the plural suffix -ون (y-...-ūna). Orthographic/pronunciation effects arise from the initial hamza.
claims.needs_review_reason: Hamza-initial verbs have orthographic/pronunciation alternations that affect exact pattern labeling; classical-sources check recommended.

claims.claim_ar: فقدان دلالي محتمل عند ترجمة يَؤْمِنُونَ فقط بـ«يؤمنون/يصدقون»؛ الجذر يحمل بعد الأمان/الثقة الذي قد لا يظهر في ترجمة أحادية.
claims.claim_en: Translation nuance: rendering يُؤْمِنُونَ simply as 'they believe' or 'they accept' may lose the root's additional sense of 'security/trust' inherent in أمِنَ; the Arabic verb can connote both believing and being secure/trusting.
claims.needs_review_reason: Semantic overlap between 'security' and 'belief' is context-dependent; consult classical lexica (Lane, Lisan) for authoritative nuance.
